# Uber Eats

> Uber Eats is an online marketplace for restaurant, grocery, convenience, retail, and alcohol delivery and pickup.

Uber Eats helps customers discover nearby merchants, place orders for delivery or pickup, track orders in real time, and manage memberships, payments, and account settings across web and mobile experiences.

## Main Experience
- [Uber Eats Home](https://www.ubereats.com/): Main entry point for browsing restaurants, groceries, and local delivery options.
- [Sign In](https://www.ubereats.com/login-redirect/): Account sign-in flow for customers accessing orders, addresses, and saved payment methods.
- [Sign Up](https://www.ubereats.com/signup): Account creation page for new Uber Eats customers.
- [Checkout](https://www.ubereats.com/checkout): Checkout flow for reviewing cart contents, delivery details, and payment.
- [Orders](https://www.ubereats.com/orders): Order history and active order tracking for signed-in customers.
- [Stores Near Me](https://www.ubereats.com/stores): Browse nearby restaurants, grocery stores, and convenience merchants by location.
- [Pickup](https://www.ubereats.com/store/pickup): Explore pickup-eligible merchants and order ahead without delivery.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.ubereats.com/us/en/gift-cards/): Purchase Uber and Uber Eats gift cards for personal or business use.

## Help and Support
- [Uber Eats Help](https://help.uber.com/ubereats): Central help hub for orders, accounts, payments, and delivery issues.
- [Account and Payment Support](https://help.uber.com/ubereats/account-and-payment): Help articles for login, payment methods, charges, and account settings.
- [Orders and Delivery Support](https://help.uber.com/ubereats/orders): Support resources for order status, cancellations, refunds, and delivery problems.
- [Membership and Pass Support](https://help.uber.com/ubereats/article/uber-one-membership-benefits-for-uber-eats-and-uber?nodeId=): Help article covering Uber One membership benefits and usage.
- [Merchant and Restaurant Support](https://help.uber.com/merchants-and-restaurants): Support hub for merchants using Uber Eats and related tools.
- [Delivery People Support](https://help.uber.com/driving-and-delivering): Support hub for couriers delivering with Uber Eats and Uber.

## Customer Features
- [Uber One](https://www.ubereats.com/us/en/uber-one/): Membership program with eligible savings, fees benefits, and member offers.
- [Group Orders](https://www.ubereats.com/us/en/group-orders/): Shared ordering feature for collecting items from multiple participants in one order.
- [Pickup Orders](https://www.ubereats.com/us/en/pickup/): Overview of pickup ordering for restaurants and other participating merchants.
- [Alcohol Delivery](https://www.ubereats.com/us/en/alcohol/): Browse alcohol delivery availability, eligibility, and participating local merchants.
- [Grocery Delivery](https://www.ubereats.com/us/en/grocery/): Grocery ordering experience for supermarkets and everyday essentials.
- [Convenience Delivery](https://www.ubereats.com/us/en/convenience/): Convenience store delivery for snacks, drinks, household items, and quick essentials.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.ubereats.com/us/en/gift-cards/): Customer gift card information and purchasing options.

## Merchant Solutions
- [Uber Eats for Merchants](https://merchants.ubereats.com/): Overview of merchant tools for restaurants, grocery, and retail businesses.
- [Restaurant Solutions](https://merchants.ubereats.com/us/en/services/restaurant-delivery/): Delivery marketplace tools and ordering solutions for restaurants.
- [Grocery Solutions](https://merchants.ubereats.com/us/en/industries/grocery/): Merchant information for grocers offering delivery and pickup through Uber Eats.
- [Retail Solutions](https://merchants.ubereats.com/us/en/industries/retail/): Retail commerce tools for local stores selling non-food items on Uber Eats.
- [POS Integrations](https://merchants.ubereats.com/us/en/technology/pos/): Point-of-sale integration information for syncing menus, orders, and operations.
- [Merchant Dashboard](https://merchants.ubereats.com/us/en/): Merchant portal entry for managing menus, stores, and performance.
- [Get Started as a Merchant](https://merchants.ubereats.com/us/en/get-started/): Onboarding path for businesses joining the Uber Eats marketplace.

## Delivery Partners
- [Deliver with Uber](https://www.uber.com/us/en/deliver/): Overview for couriers earning by delivering food, groceries, and other orders.
- [Sign Up to Deliver](https://www.uber.com/us/en/deliver/signup/): Courier signup flow for starting delivery work with Uber.
- [Delivery Requirements](https://www.uber.com/us/en/deliver/requirements/): Eligibility and document requirements for delivery partners.
- [Vehicle Requirements](https://www.uber.com/us/en/deliver/vehicle-requirements/): Vehicle, bike, scooter, and other transport requirements by market.
- [Courier Earnings](https://www.uber.com/us/en/deliver/basics/earnings/): Information about how delivery earnings, tips, and payouts work.
- [Delivery App Overview](https://www.uber.com/us/en/deliver/basics/): Introductory information about delivering with the Uber Driver app.

## Business and Enterprise
- [Uber for Business - Meals](https://www.uber.com/us/en/business/solutions/meal-programs/): Business meal programs for employee meals, stipends, and team ordering.
- [Uber for Business](https://www.uber.com/us/en/business/): Enterprise platform for rides, meals, and delivery management.
- [Business Gift Cards](https://www.uber.com/us/en/business/gift-cards/): Corporate gift card purchasing for employee rewards and customer incentives.
- [Vouchers](https://www.uber.com/us/en/business/solutions/vouchers/): Sponsored meal and delivery vouchers for promotions, support, and events.
- [Central](https://www.uber.com/us/en/business/solutions/central/): Dashboard for coordinating rides and meal delivery on behalf of others.

## Company and News
- [About Uber Eats](https://about.ubereats.com/): Company overview describing the Uber Eats platform and how it works.
- [Uber Newsroom](https://www.uber.com/newsroom/): Official news and announcements from Uber, including Uber Eats updates.
- [Uber Blog](https://www.uber.com/blog/): Company blog with product, policy, and marketplace stories.
- [Careers at Uber](https://www.uber.com/us/en/careers/): Job listings and company information for roles across Uber and Uber Eats.
- [Investor Relations](https://investor.uber.com/): Financial reports, filings, and investor information for Uber Technologies.

## Legal and Policies
- [Terms of Use](https://www.uber.com/legal/en/document/?name=general-terms-of-use&country=united-states&lang=en): General terms governing use of Uber and Uber Eats services.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.uber.com/legal/en/document/?name=privacy-notice&country=united-states&lang=en): Privacy policy describing data collection, use, and sharing practices.
- [Cookie Notice](https://www.uber.com/legal/en/document/?name=cookie-notice&country=united-states&lang=en): Cookie policy covering tracking technologies and browser-related preferences.
- [Consumer Health Data Privacy Notice](https://www.uber.com/legal/en/document/?name=consumer-health-data-privacy-notice&country=united-states&lang=en): Privacy notice for applicable consumer health data handling requirements.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://www.uber.com/us/en/accessibility/): Accessibility information for Uber and Uber Eats digital services.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.uber.com/us/en/safety/uber-community-guidelines/): Rules and expectations for users, merchants, and delivery partners.
